verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI's docs say users can set a time-to-live for audio and transcripts, which automatically deletes them, and can opt out of the model improvement program, all self-serve from the dashboard. That covers the core of retention and deletion control, but the evidence is a single summary line. missing for 10: an explicit on-demand delete API or endpoint for transcripts and audio, in-depth retention docs (TTL ranges, defaults, streaming coverage), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: opt out of the model improvement program, set a time-to-live for audio and transcripts, and sign a BAA, all self-serve from the dashboard.
